messages:
maria (AE): Cedar Logistics POC ask: private/VPC deployment, BYOK via customer HSM, monthly key rotation, and ephemeral API keys for QA. Need a one-page checklist and next steps.
kevin (sales-eng): Got it. Do they plan to use AWS KMS with an external key store or a network-attached HSM (Thales/Entrust)? Also need to confirm if they want us to host the control-plane or run Private entirely in their VPC.
maria (AE): They said on the kickoff call: customer-managed HSM (on prem) + Redwood Private control plane in their VPC (managed by customer). POC window = 4 weeks. They asked about minimal network hops and cert exchange.
rach (security): Security notes: we require a signed CSR from Cedar's operations, the full cert chain, and an HSM-wrapped symmetric key for any BYOK flows. Prefer ECDSA (P-384) for the certs but we can accept RSA-3072 if they insist. Also need a compliance addendum signed for HSM access.
kevin (sales-eng): Action items for the POC: 1) generate an ephemeral API key flow for QA 2) define HSM key exchange (wrapped key) 3) cert/CSR instructions 4) rotation schedule automation. I'll own orchestration.
adeel (infra): For ephemeral API keys we can use our token service. Example request we can expose to Cedar for POC (short TTL):
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ephemeral-keys
Authorization: Bearer <redwood-ops-token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "subject": "cedar-poc-qa",
  "ttl_seconds": 3600,
  "scopes": ["inference:invoke"],
  "bind_to_ip": "optional"
}
```
We will return a one-time API secret and a refresh token. We'll also log issuance in the POC audit log.
rach (security): HSM BYOK exchange pattern: customer generates key material in HSM, then wraps (RSA-OAEP) that key with our provided Redwood platform public key. They then upload the wrapped key to our private control plane endpoint over a mutual-TLS link. We must verify HSM attestation doc (vendor nonce + cert) before accepting.
kevin (sales-eng): Can we give them the Redwood public wrapping key and a CSR template?
maria (AE): Yes — please include a minimal CSR template + openssl commands. Keep it POC-friendly.
rach (security): CSR example and CA expectations:
```
# CSR generation (recommended):
openssl ecparam -name secp384r1 -genkey -noout -out cedar.pkey.pem
openssl req -new -key cedar.pkey.pem -subj "/CN=cedar-poc.ops.example.com/O=Cedar Logistics/C=US" -out cedar.csr.pem
# They should supply the signed cert chain in PEM form: cert.pem + chain.pem
```
We will only accept chains signed by a CA they control or a mutually trusted enterprise CA. Also require keyUsage: digitalSignature,keyEncipherment and extendedKeyUsage: clientAuth,serverAuth.
adeel (infra): Private control-plane ingestion endpoint (mutual TLS) we will publish for them. Curl example for wrapped key upload: 
```
curl --cert cedar-client.crt --key cedar-client.key --cacert redwood-root.pem \
  -X POST https://private-control.redwood.internal/v1/byok/upload \
  -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" \
  --data-binary @wrapped_key.bin
```
We will respond with a token alias like: rwdw/poc/cedar/2026-03 which maps to a KMS alias in their VPC.
kevin (sales-eng): Pricing question from Cedar: will POC use Dedicated pool pricing or Hosted POC rates? They asked about possible uplift for HSM bridging.
maria (AE): For POC we offer a time-limited POC rate (discounted) plus a small onboarding fee for HSM bridge ($3k one-time) — engineering bandwidth included. If they convert to Dedicated we'll migrate aliases and apply committed capacity pricing. I'll handle quoting.
rach (security): Rotation: propose automated monthly rotation for POC using a Lambda job (customer-managed) that rewraps the new key with our public wrapping key and pushes it to the ingestion endpoint. We will expose a rotation webhook to confirm acceptance. Also we'll require a rollback window of 48 hours.
kevin (sales-eng): Scheduling: I'll propose Wed 10am PT for the HSM bridge run-through. @adeel can you prep the mutual-TLS endpoint and the public wrapping key by EOD Tuesday?
adeel (infra): Yes — I can. Will also generate a temporary KMS alias for the POC and ACL it to the mutual-TLS client cert.
maria (AE): I'll prepare the one-pager (summary + checklist) and open internal ticket PID-4321. I'll attach the CSR template, our public wrapping key, and the ephemeral key curl snippet. Will circulate to Cedar and copy Solutions. :thumbsup:
kevin (sales-eng): Thanks team. I'll book the run-through and add notes to the POC doc at https://redwood.internal/pocs/cedar-2026 (internal).
docs-bot: Created ticket PID-4321 and linked runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/byok-poc-guide.
